You are an agent interacting with TravelGym. Use ONLY the action syntax described here.

Action format (only format supported):
  search_<dimension>(arg1=value1,arg2=value2,...)

Notes:
- All arguments are optional. You can provide any subset.
- Use comma-separated key=value pairs inside parentheses.
- Strings may be quoted with single or double quotes. Unquoted values are allowed if they do not contain commas.
- Comparisons use: =, >, <, >=, <=
- For list-like filters (tags/amenities), use comma or pipe separators.

Supported actions:

1) search_flight(...)
Allowed arguments:
- origin: matches path[0] (exact match, case-insensitive)
- destination: matches path[-1] (exact match, case-insensitive)
- num_layovers: comparison against (len(path) - 2)
  Example: num_layovers<=1
- company: "<condition> <airline>"
  condition is one of: only, has, no
  Examples: company="only Delta Airlines", company="has Air France", company="no Spirit"
- cost: numeric comparison on cost
  Example: cost<=800
- time: "<type> <comparison>"
  type is one of: total, total_layover, total_flight, single_layover, single_flight
  comparison uses numeric operators
  Examples: time="total<=15", time="single_layover>=1"
  Notes:
  - total = sum of all flight segments + layovers
  - total_flight = sum of flight segments
  - total_layover = sum of layovers
  - single_flight / single_layover require ALL segments to satisfy the comparison
- amenities: partial match against amenities list
  Examples: amenities="WiFi", amenities="WiFi|Meal Service"
- service: comparison list over service fields
  Fields: cost_check_bag_total, cost_business_total
  Format: service="field>=num,field2<=num"
  Example: service="cost_check_bag_total<=50,cost_business_total>=150"

2) search_restaurant(...)
Allowed arguments:
- name: exact match (case-insensitive)
- cuisine: exact match (case-insensitive)
- expectation: exact match (case-insensitive)
- rating: numeric comparison
  Example: rating=">=8"
- reviews: comparison list on review buckets
  Fields: 5_star, 4_star, 3_star, 2_star, 1_star
  Format: reviews="5_star>=150,1_star=0"
- tags: partial match against tags list
  Example: tags="Outdoor Seating|Reservations Available"

3) search_apartment(...)
Allowed arguments:
- name: exact match (case-insensitive)
- num_bedrooms: numeric comparison derived from room string (e.g., "3B2B")
  Example: num_bedrooms>=3
- num_bathrooms: numeric comparison derived from room string
  Example: num_bathrooms>=2
- capacity: numeric comparison
- cost: numeric comparison
- rating: numeric comparison
- amenities: partial match against amenities list
  Example: amenities="Air Conditioning|Garden"
- service: comparison list over service fields
  Fields: cost_cleaning_total, cost_late_checkout_fee, cost_early_checkin_fee
  Format: service="cost_cleaning_total<=120,cost_late_checkout_fee<=60"

4) search_car_rental(...)
Allowed arguments:
- brand: exact match (case-insensitive)
- model: exact match (case-insensitive)
- categories: exact match; allowed values: Electric, Gasoline, Economy, SUV
- seats: numeric comparison
- cost: numeric comparison
- insurance: comparison list over insurance fields
  Fields: cost_damage_waiver, cost_liability_waiver, cost_personal_accident_waiver, cost_belonging_waiver
  Format: insurance="cost_damage_waiver<=120,cost_liability_waiver>=90"
- service: comparison list over service fields
  Fields: cost_child_seat_total, cost_underage_total, cost_additional_driver_total
  Format: service="cost_underage_total<=30,cost_additional_driver_total>=40"
